units.source_text: 他说到这里，回头向藤式部丞一望。

en.t: Having said this, he turned back and glanced at Fuji Shikibu no Jo.

units.source_text: 藤式部丞有几个妹妹，声望甚佳。

en.t: Fuji Shikibu no Jo had several younger sisters, and they were very well regarded.

units.source_text: 他想道：左马头这话莫非为我的妹妹而发？

en.t: He wondered, Could the Captain of the Left Division of the Stables have said this because of my sisters?
So he remained silent and said nothing.
